rationale: Both documents explicitly name Raman et al. 2026 / white-bear steering as the source and both credit the method as building on it: using the same mean-difference vector construction but a different, previously-unused contrast (think vs. suppress/secret-preference) rather than the paper's think vs. don't-think pair, with cosine ≈0.85 overlap disclosed in both. The message adds a concrete replication detail (reproducing the paper's exact reported number to validate the pipeline) not in the write-up, while slightly softening the novelty framing ('same family rather than overturning it') compared to the write-up's stronger claim that the contrast, semantics and dose are 'distinct from the published method'.
